build.platform: Windows 11 x86 (MSVC 2022, meson debugoptimized, strict warnings)
build.source: HEAD plus this slice, exported clean; every development gate on; 1,499 targets, no warnings

diagnosticRuntime.change: S_JKAVoiceVolume answers 0 with an audio backend running instead of refusing; nothing else

jamp.exe 1.01.tool: Capstone x86-32 over the PE image

imports.51 CG_S_ADDLOCALSET: 0x412aae; real time against the caller's client-game time; unserved

update.lookup: 0x467360; an absent name returns before anything else
update.play: 0x4682c0, current slot first with [0x12a4d0c], then old with [0x12a4d10]

fade.old: while > 0: 255 less the same; at 0 or below 0 and the slot let go (old = -1)
fade.arithmetic: x87 at double precision; whole numbers and the quotient stored as floats; _ftol 0x539584 truncates

playSet.interval: irand(+0x44, +0x48) * 1000 drawn every frame; a signed comparison with now - last
playSet.volume: lo, hi = ftol(float(bound) * float(volume / 255.0f)); irand(lo, hi) as a byte, held at or below the set volume

loops.ambient: 0x46b270: at most 32 a frame (count 0xc717b0), its own volume
loops.mix: 0x46b350: loops of one sound one channel, volumes summed and clamped at 255

subWave.channel: 7 (CHAN_AMBIENT), fixed origin, master volume as given
subWave.silent: nothing started for volume 0 while the flag at 0x12a4c78 is set; its meaning not established

lifetimes.parse: 0x467c50 adds a parse's sets under new numbers; a name finds its newest set

data.city_outdoor: loopedWave ambience/outdoor/city_lp, volRange 250 255, timeBetweenWaves 0 0, no subWaves
data.mp/ffa1 worldspawn soundSet: none (the client game asks for default, which is not declared)

live.command: python scripts/probe_legacy_sessions.py --profiles jka-mp --directions join --runtime .tmp/runtime/jka-live-join --sessions main kick

diagnostic.sound: OpenAL, system OpenAL32.dll Generic Software, offscreen-muted, s_alDebugDump three frames apart at 60 fps
diagnostic.voice: loop ent=1023 sample=sound/ambience/outdoor/city_lp.wav mode=3d dist=0.0 occ=0.00 tone=world
diagnostic.reconnect: diag-audio-3: absent for the six dumps while the client reloaded, then gain 1.00 from the first frames; the sound system was not restarted
